intro: At Hallow's End, Darnassus innkeepers hand out festive marzipan to visitors who dance for it. Crafted in the night elven capital for the autumn celebration, this sweet is one of four treats Jesper needs.

sections.t: A Taste of the World Tree
p: During Hallow's End, Alliance capitals share a tradition of lighthearted trick-or-treating. Dwarves offer sharp mints, Stormwind makes chewy nougat, and Darnassus innkeepers prepare delicate marzipan for visitors. To receive a piece, you must show some festive spirit and dance when the innkeeper asks. The sweet is one of four regional treats sought by Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind's Cathedral Square who cannot go out to collect sweets himself.
